GMAC: Acronym of Galois Message Authentication Code.
GMAIL: A web-based e-mail system provided by Google (trademarked Gmail).
GMAJOR: The major key with the notes G, A, B, C, D, E, F♯, the key signature of which has one sharp.
GMAN: A US government agent fighting organized crime in the interwar years.
GMAT: Acronym of Graduate Management Admission Test.
GMEN: A nickname of the New York Giants football team.
GMINOR: a minor key with the notes G, A, B♭, C, D, E♭, F
